unDef.description: The effect of declaring a top-level class with a name of the form a_SJb, where a is the name of an existing class included in the SQLJ application and b has the form of a Java identifier.
The features, extensions, and/or behaviors that the JavaBean component, acting as a profile customizer that customizes a profile.
SQL execution accomplished by implementing runtime library components.
The customization objects in a profile.
If invocation of a ConnectionContext object’s isClosed method would return the value true, then the effect of invoking any methods other than isClosed and close against that object.
The behavior of a customization object in a profile.
The effect of violating SQLJ’s reserved package namespace.
The effect of violating SQLJ’s reserved variable namespace.
The effect if the name of a file included with the application has the same format as names of files that might be generated by an SQLJ translator, possibly as the names of resource files.
The behavior of subsequent invocations of an object’s named accessor methods after the invocation of a NamedIterator object’s next() method has returned false.
The behavior of subsequent invocations of a ResultSetIterator object’s methods after the invocation of a ResultSetIterator object’s isClosed() method has returned true.

If SQLJ runtime does not support this ResultSet iterator object’s declared sensitivity ‹with value› of SENSITIVE or INSENSITIVE, then the result of invoking getSensitivity against that ResultSet iterator object.
Once a RTStatement object’s executeComplete method has been called, the effect of further calls to any of its other methods.
The effects of a call to any getXXX method of an RTStatement object whose associated EntryInfo object’s getStatementType() method returns PREPARED_STATEMENT.
The non-JDBC driver that is required to be registered by the implementation for the SQL type for this class description.
The profile transformations that profile customization typically involves allow more efficient SQL execution (such as pre-compilation of SQL text or use of SQL-invoked procedures).
The maximum batch size may be finite but not specified.
The order of the TypeInfo objects in the Result Set Info of the Result Set Column Java fields of Profile EntryInfo for a ‹query clause› whose associated iterator object is a ‹named iterator›.

If a generated connection class’s getProfileKey method is called with a profile loader PL and a profile name PN and a profile key object does not already exist for the profile named PN loaded with profile loader PL, then the profile key object that is returned.
If a runtime exception condition is raised during the execution of an ‹executable clause›, then the values of any OUT or INOUT ‹embedded Java expression›s.
If the execution of a ‹fetch statement› results in a row not found, then the values of the ‹embedded Java expression›s contained in the ‹fetch target list›.
If a ResultSetIterator object has not had its fetch size set by invocation of its setFetchSize method, or has a fetch size of 0 (zero), then the value resulting from invocation of getFetchSize.
If the int value specified in invocation of setFetchSize against this ResultSet iterator object is 0 (zero), then the fetch size.

The manner in which, at runtime, a registered Customization object can make a user identifier, stored in a customized profile, the user identifier for privilege checking of that profile object’s statements.
